svg.title: Known-best packing of 308 unit squares
svg.desc: The retained known-best n=308 construction, normalized to Witness/v2 and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete bc0708f rational centre/half-angle certificate converted exactly from the retained source. Finite construction feasibility only; no KKT, local minimum, rigidity, novelty, priority or global optimality claim.
